scripts.dev: npm run dev -w apps/server & npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.test: npm test -w packages/core && npm test -w apps/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p apps/server --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
